methods.label: Bound the full interior-angle sum
methods.explanation: Each interior angle of a convex polygon is less than \(180^\circ\). Let the number of sides be \(n\). Then \((n-2)\times180\) is greater than 1300 but exceeds 1300 by less than 180, giving \((n-2)\times180=1440\). The required interior angle is \(1440-1300=140^\circ\).
methods.levelReason: The argument combines the Grade 8 interior-angle sum formula with the elementary bound on a convex interior angle.
